verdict.rationale: Kick documents individual close-related features: monthly reconciliation, period locks applied after an accountant reviews and closes a period, and an accrual ledger on the Plus plan. Nothing in the evidence shows a month-end close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals and review sign-offs as tasks. The MCP mention of automating month-end checks is a developer building block, and the other features are adjacent controls, so neither counts as the checklist itself.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
